tasks.notes: Full step-by-step in MAINTENANCE.md section 'Annual secret rotation'. Short version: @BotFather /revoke -> update TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN in GitHub Secrets -> setWebhook with the new bot token. New `openssl rand -hex 32` -> update TELEGRAM_SECRET_TOKEN in Cloudflare -> setWebhook again with the new secret. Verify with the curl check in webhook/README.md before trusting it. Then bump this date +1 year and commit.
tasks.title: Annual rotation: bot token + webhook secret
